```{r}
# ============================================================
# DISTRIBUCIÓN BERNOULLI
# X ~ Bernoulli(p)
# En R se trabaja como una Binomial con size = 1
# ============================================================

p <- 0.60

# P(X = x)
dbinom(0, size = 1, prob = p)
dbinom(1, size = 1, prob = p)

# P(X <= x)
pbinom(0, size = 1, prob = p)
pbinom(1, size = 1, prob = p)

# Cuantil
qbinom(0.60, size = 1, prob = p)

# Generación de valores aleatorios
rbinom(10, size = 1, prob = p)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# DISTRIBUCIÓN BINOMIAL
# X ~ Binomial(n, p)
# ============================================================

n <- 10
p <- 0.30
x <- 0:n

# P(X = x)
dbinom(x, size = n, prob = p)

# P(X <= x)
pbinom(x, size = n, prob = p)

# Cuantiles
qbinom(c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75), size = n, prob = p)

# Generación de valores aleatorios
rbinom(20, size = n, prob = p)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# DISTRIBUCIÓN POISSON
# X ~ Poisson(lambda)
# ============================================================

lambda <- 4
x <- 0:15

# P(X = x)
dpois(x, lambda = lambda)

# P(X <= x)
ppois(x, lambda = lambda)

# Cuantiles
qpois(c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75), lambda = lambda)

# Generación de valores aleatorios
rpois(20, lambda = lambda)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# DISTRIBUCIÓN GEOMÉTRICA
# X = número de fracasos antes del primer éxito
# ============================================================

p <- 0.25
x <- 0:15

# P(X = x)
dgeom(x, prob = p)

# P(X <= x)
pgeom(x, prob = p)

# Cuantiles
qgeom(c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75), prob = p)

# Generación de valores aleatorios
rgeom(20, prob = p)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# DISTRIBUCIÓN HIPERGEOMÉTRICA
# m = número de elementos tipo éxito
# n = número de elementos tipo fracaso
# k = tamaño de la muestra
# ============================================================

m <- 8
n <- 12
k <- 5
x <- 0:k

# P(X = x)
dhyper(x, m = m, n = n, k = k)

# P(X <= x)
phyper(x, m = m, n = n, k = k)

# Cuantiles
qhyper(c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75), m = m, n = n, k = k)

# Generación de valores aleatorios
rhyper(20, m = m, n = n, k = k)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# DISTRIBUCIÓN BINOMIAL NEGATIVA
# X = número de fracasos antes de alcanzar size éxitos
# ============================================================

size <- 4
p <- 0.40
x <- 0:20

# P(X = x)
dnbinom(x, size = size, prob = p)

# P(X <= x)
pnbinom(x, size = size, prob = p)

# Cuantiles
qnbinom(c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75), size = size, prob = p)

# Generación de valores aleatorios
rnbinom(20, size = size, prob = p)
```
